column1: # Which hosts may decrypt which directory of the secauto store.

# work). Fill one row at a time and check srv still renders after each: run
# `ssh srv gopass show -o <entry>` for an entry in that directory, then wait for
# the next secauto-pull. A directory missing here keeps its current recipients.
